- Helper changes can invalidate guard adapters, profile certification and source bindings; TASK-027 and TASK-029 must complete before readiness.

### Acceptance criteria

- Every overwritten/new root file is listed with exact source, prior destination hash, new hash and preservation boundary; no whole-tree overwrite is inferred from prior parity.

### Planned verification

- Reopen source/destination bytes immediately before adoption and reject stale preconditions or customized conflicts.
- Review the post-adoption diff and exact parity/approved adaptations; do not commit, push or modify another project.
- If the existing guard repair route cannot safely bind the selected change set, stop and revise the bounded repair design rather than bypass it.
